instruction: Check pod security policies (PSP v1beta1 or PSA)
output: kubectl get psp 2>/dev/null; kubectl get ns -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.metadata.annotations.pod-security\.kubernetes\.io/enforce}{"\n"}{end}'

instruction: Create an OPA Gatekeeper constraint template

output:
kubectl apply -f - << 'EOF'
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sRequiredLabels
metadata:
  name: require-owner
spec:
  match:
    kinds:
    - apiGroups: [""]
      kinds: ["Namespace"]
  parameters:
    labels: ["owner"]
EOF

cat > kyverno-policy.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: require-labels
spec:
  rules:
  - name: check-owner
    match:
      resources:
        kinds:
        - Pod
    validate:
      message: "label 'owner' is required"
      pattern:
        metadata:
          labels:
            owner: "*?*"
EOF
kubectl apply -f kyverno-policy.yaml

cat > cm-propagate.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: shared-config
  annotations:
    config.kubernetes.io/local-config: "true"
data:
  key: value
EOF
kubectl apply -f cm-propagate.yaml
ps aux | grep kube-apiserver | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -- '--' | head -20
ps aux | grep kube-controller | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -- '--' | head -20
ps aux | grep kube-scheduler | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -- '--' | head -20
kubectl get configmap -n kube-system kube-proxy -o yaml | grep -i mode
kubectl get configmap -n kube-system coredns -o yaml
